mapper.delete: delete from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE p where p.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: select * from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE p where p.project_id = #{projectId} and not exists (select * from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE his where his.prj_survive_id = p.ref_prj_survive_id)
select * from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE p where p.project_id = #{hisProjectId} and not exists (select * from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE his where his.ref_prj_survive_id = p.prj_survive_id)

select p.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS, his.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS his_manage_requirements from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE p,PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE his where p.project_id = #{projectId} and his.prj_survive_id = p.ref_prj_survive_id and his.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS = p.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS

select p.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS, his.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS his_manage_requirements from PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE p,PRJ_PROJECT_SURVIVE_REQUIRE his where p.project_id = #{projectId} and his.prj_survive_id = p.ref_prj_survive_id and his.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS != p.MANAGE_REQUIREMENTS
